_doc: Every creature ability the combat engine implements. params lists each accepted parameter with its default. GameData.validate() rejects unknown ability ids and parameters, and tests/unit/test_abilities.gd covers every entry. Effects live in src/combat/combat_simulator.gd and src/combat/ability_effects.gd.

ranged.name: Ranged
ranged.desc: Shoots from the back line from round 1; weak when forced into melee.

flying.name: Flying
flying.desc: Reaches the enemy in round 1 and prefers to dive on the back line. In the air between its strikes: ground melee without reach cannot attack it until it lands to strike.

reach.name: Reach
reach.desc: Long spears, great size or a long tail: can strike flyers in the air.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.desc: Each melee blow sweeps on into up to targets other stacks within reach for fraction of the damage.

breath.name: Breath
breath.desc: Each attack rolls past its target into a stack behind it (archers and supporters first) for fraction of the damage.

charge.name: Charge
charge.desc: First melee attack of the battle deals +bonus damage.

brace.name: Brace
brace.desc: Negates an incoming charge and retaliates harder against it.

guardian.name: Guardian
guardian.desc: Makes it harder for enemy flankers to slip past the front line.

heal.name: Heal
heal.desc: Restores hit points to the most wounded ally (only allies with tag, if set), raising fallen creatures.

inspire.name: Inspire
inspire.desc: +morale to the whole army (strongest source counts).

curse.name: Curse
curse.desc: Shot targets deal reduced damage for the rest of the round.

unwavering.name: Unwavering
unwavering.desc: Morale can never drop below zero.

mindless.name: Mindless
mindless.desc: Morale is always exactly zero: never surges, never falters, immune to fear.

first_strike.name: First Strike
first_strike.desc: When attacked in melee, retaliates before the attacker's blow lands.

riposte.name: Riposte
riposte.desc: Retaliates against every melee attack, not just the first each round.

double_strike.name: Double Strike
double_strike.desc: Each attack or shot is followed by a second one at mult damage (no extra retaliation).

splash.name: Splash
splash.desc: Each attack or shot also hits a second enemy stack for fraction of the damage.

poison.name: Poison
poison.desc: fraction of damage dealt is dealt again at the start of the next round, ignoring defense.

life_drain.name: Life Drain
life_drain.desc: Heals itself for fraction of damage dealt, raising its own fallen.

regenerate.name: Regenerate
regenerate.desc: Restores amount hit points at the start of each round (never above the top creature's maximum).

stun.name: Stun
stun.desc: Each hit has chance to make the target lose its next action.

evasion.name: Evasion
evasion.desc: chance to avoid an incoming attack or shot entirely.

sunder.name: Sunder
sunder.desc: Each hit permanently lowers the target's defense by amount (at most cap in total).

armor_pierce.name: Armor Pierce
armor_pierce.desc: Ignores fraction of the target's defense.

momentum.name: Momentum
momentum.desc: +per_round damage for every round after the first (up to cap).

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.desc: Enemy melee attackers are drawn onto this stack with this chance.

fear.name: Fear
fear.desc: -morale to the whole enemy army (strongest source counts; mindless units are immune).

aura.name: Aura
aura.desc: Every allied stack (including itself) gains these stats. Auras of the same stat do not stack; the strongest counts.

rebirth.name: Rebirth
rebirth.desc: Once per battle, when destroyed, fraction of its starting number rises again.

skirmisher.name: Skirmisher
skirmisher.desc: Ranged unit that fights at full strength when engaged in melee.
